title: Astronomer with Celestial Globe
description: A woman in a striped dress sits on a wooden stool with her back to the viewer, writing with a quill in an open book resting on a large ornate armillary sphere. The sphere has golden rings with inscriptions and a blue rod, with torn pages and red ink spilling from the book.
prompt: A woman with her back to the viewer wearing a striped blue-grey dress sits on a wooden stool writing with a red quill in an open book placed on a large ornate golden armillary sphere with inscribed rings and a blue rod. Torn pages with writing and red ink are spilling from the book. Behind her is a large arched stained glass window showing constellations against a twilight sky, dramatic swirling clouds frame the scene in a detailed fantasy painting style
